comparison.objective: Perform the pull–wipe–reseat–pull dipstick procedure, read the oil level, report it, and restore the setup.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential extraction/insertion, bimanual wiping, visual state reading, and report placement.
comparison.success_condition: Valid wiped-and-reseated reading, correct report, dipstick reseated, rag put down, and objects released.
comparison.reason: Although it includes sliding insertion and reseating, its tested ability is procedural inspection and state reporting, not continuous support and containment across a rail-to-jig transfer.
